title: a quiet morning in a cabin by the woods
en: i didn't think i'd share a video with you this week because i was feeling quite lacking in creative energy but as i traveled west and the bear mountains and rugged canyons turned into the lush forests and beaches of the washington peninsula i felt different the skies were blue and had a sweet wet scent i felt a spark of inspiration to travel freely and experience the natural world again i also got to share this trip with my boyfriend we've never taken a trip together and it was a very special time for us it got me thinking about my past self and how my life has changed loneliness is a feeling i struggled with for years as many of us do i've found it isn't always a feeling

dependent on whether or not you have a lot of friends or an active social life it's about your relationship with yourself about fearing being alone with your own thoughts and yet feeling lonely because you do not have a deep connection with yourself and others i think most everyone feels different at some point in their lives for a lot of us this happens during our younger years these are times when we're discovering who we are and it's natural that we feel like we cannot relate to a vast majority of people but it makes us feel alone like we don't belong yet the mere fact that this is such a common feeling shows us that that isn't always true there are thousands of books and videos

and testaments all about this feeling of otherness it is proof that we have so much more in common with each other than not at any given point for example i've never been able to handle more than a couple close friendships at a time and i'm quickly overwhelmed after several days of a lot of socializing it used to make me feel like something was wrong but now i know that many people are introverted like myself it's very common over time i've found people that value me and hold my trust but in my case those relationships took many many years to build to be clear i have no doubt each and every one of us has a truly unique light that wants to shine ever brighter as we grow and love for ourselves

we have an individual imprint but we are also more connected to others than not i've come to see it as a responsibility to interact with my world with an open heart to accept others assuming we share common ground it has helped me feel far less lonely and encouraged me to connect and to give a very practical way i combated loneliness was by investing time in myself and my hobbies but also by

accepting that every emotion is an opportunity i also let go of my pride and admitted to myself that in my case i wanted to live my life near my family in typical hispanic culture i was raised with a sense of constant togetherness i miss that living alone in the city and even though i was teased at times for wanting to be near my parents it's what i knew would make me happier and less lonely i've lived my own individual life and made my own decisions while still living near my family and that worked for me i'm no less of an adult of course and i'm happier because of that decision through that i realized how important it is to know your own heart instead of mindlessly adhering to what your society dictates is the definition of success and true independence

i can certainly say that i still feel lonely from time to time i think for some of us it's a natural occurrence but i don't see that loneliness as negative if anything it reminds me to value my spirituality and to not take for granted the blessings in my life whoever you are and whatever chapter you are in your life i hope that you can continue to embrace the story and know that we're always evolving and that who you will be tomorrow is not yet known distracted

thank you all for your lovely words in my last video i recently got a call from my brother saying that we finally have blue skies again it may only be temporary but it is so exciting and a great reminder that no matter how dark things get the light will always come back
it's just a matter of time i will share more of my trip next week so far it has been wonderful to get away from everything and i'm sending you my love have a wonderful day or night you
zh: 我没想到这周我会和你分享视频，因为我感觉自己非常缺乏创造力，但是当我向西旅行时，熊山和崎岖的峡谷变成了华盛顿半岛茂密的森林和海滩，我感觉不同了，天空是蓝色的，有一种甜美的湿润气味，我感受到了自由旅行和再次体验自然世界的灵感火花，我还必须和我的男朋友分享这次旅行，我们从未一起旅行过，这对我们来说是一个非常特别的时刻，它让我思考了我的生活。过去的自己以及我的生活如何改变孤独是我多年来与我们许多人一样挣扎的一种感觉，我发现它并不总是一种感觉

取决于你是否有很多朋友或活跃的社交生活，这与你与自己的关系有关，害怕独自思考自己的想法，但又感到孤独，因为你与自己和他人没有深厚的联系，我想大多数人在生活中的某个时刻对我们很多人来说都是不同的，这种情况发生在我们年轻的时候，这是我们发现自己是谁的时候，很自然地，我们感觉自己无法与绝大多数人建立联系，但这让我们感到孤独，就像我们还不属于自己一样这种普遍的感觉告诉我们，事实并非总是如此，有数以千计的书籍和视频

和所有关于这种差异感的证明，它证明我们彼此之间有更多的共同点，而不是在任何特定的时刻，例如，我从来没有能够一次处理超过几个亲密的友谊，经过几天的大量社交活动后，我很快就不知所措，这曾经让我觉得有些不对劲，但现在我知道很多人像我一样内向，随着时间的推移，这是很常见的，我找到了重视我并信任我的人，但就我而言，这些关系需要多年的努力才能清楚地表明，我毫不怀疑我们每个人都拥有真正独特的光芒，随着我们的成长和对自己的爱，它希望变得更加明亮
我们有个人印记，但我们与他人的联系也比没有联系更紧密，我开始认为以开放的心与我的世界互动是一种责任，接受他人，假设我们有共同点，它帮助我感觉不那么孤独，鼓励我与人联系，并提供一种非常实用的方法，我对抗孤独的方法是在自己和我的爱好上投入时间，但也通过

接受每一种情感都是一次机会，我也放弃了我的骄傲，并向自己承认，就我而言，我想在典型的西班牙文化中靠近我的家人生活，我在一种持续的团结感中长大，我怀念独自生活在城市的感觉，尽管我有时因为想要靠近我的父母而被嘲笑，但我知道这会让我更快乐，不那么孤独，我过着自己的个人生活，在仍然住在我的家人附近的同时做出了自己的决定，这对我有用，我不当然，我不再是一个成年人了，我更高兴，因为这个决定让我意识到了解自己的内心是多么重要，而不是盲目地遵循社会的规定，这才是成功和真正独立的定义
我可以肯定地说，我仍然时不时地感到孤独，我认为对我们中的一些人来说，这是一种自然现象，但我并不认为孤独是消极的，如果它提醒我珍惜我的灵性，不要把我生命中的祝福视为理所当然，无论你是谁，无论你在生命中的什么阶段，我希望你能继续拥抱这个故事，并知道我们总是在进化，而你明天会是谁还不知道。
谢谢大家在我上一个视频中所说的可爱的话，我最近接到我兄弟的电话，说我们终于再次拥有蓝天了，这可能只是暂时的，但它是如此令人兴奋，也是一个很好的提醒，无论事情变得多么黑暗，光明总会回来
这只是时间问题，下周我将分享更多我的旅行到目前为止，远离一切事情真是太棒了，我正在向你发送我的爱人祝你度过美好的一天或夜晚
